rationale: Price at $10.00 remains above session VWAP ($9.73) and the 5m 9-EMA ($9.96), sitting in the upper 93% of today's range on 7.25x relative volume, so the breakout structure that justified entry is still intact and the original $9.84 invalidation has not been approached. The last five 1m candles show tight consolidation near the highs rather than distribution, and with no adverse news the case for flipping short is weak; the modest -0.57% drawdown does not warrant abandoning a still-valid setup, though the stalled momentum and thin remaining loss budget argue against adding size.
